alternativeSelection.assessment: The broad closest match covers Utrecht’s programme-wide psychology and research core. Brain and cognition and social and organisational psychology are independently evidenced, coherent, mechanically feasible and substantively distinct additional routes. Clinical/mental-health and developmental directions were also assessed, but three UCR alternatives is the maximum.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both study social cognition, attitudes and group behavior.
Both study cognitive, social and emotional development across the lifespan.
Utrecht examines psychology as a scientific discipline. UCR develops scientific reasoning across several courses.
Both introduce brain function and the links between biology and behavior.
Both examine psychological disorders and their explanations.
Both examine attention and memory. The UCR course approaches these functions through neuroscience.
Utrecht offers dedicated clinical theory. UCR studies related topics in psychopathology and health psychology.
Utrecht studies cognitive changes in clinical settings. UCR focuses on mechanisms of perception and cognition.
Utrecht focuses on clinical questions in child development. UCR studies development across the lifespan.
Both use research designs and statistical inference to answer psychological questions.
Utrecht develops advanced statistical analysis. UCR’s advanced psychology methods course focuses on systematic reviews and meta-analysis.
Both introduce research design, measurement and statistical inference.
Both introduce Python programming. Utrecht’s training uses examples from psychology.
This course examines motivation and self-regulation in everyday life.
This course examines how contemporary technologies affect behavior and well-being.
Utrecht offers dedicated practice in developing and running experiments. UCR studies experimental design alongside statistics.
Utrecht requires a supervised 15 EC research project. UCR’s optional independent research is shown separately.
Utrecht provides structured practice in psychological interviewing. UCR studies communication and assessment across several courses.
Use the profiling space for eligible electives, a minor or study abroad, subject to the degree’s level requirements.

The UCR plans cover substantial areas of psychology and related methods. Clinical practice and professional qualifications require further dedicated training.
